query: My Parallel MCP Client Tool uses SSE and cannot connect. Should I add an API key?
expected_behavior: Use Streamable HTTP (httpStreamable) with MCP Client Tool version 1.2 or newer
Keep the anonymous /mcp endpoint rather than /mcp-oauth
Refresh tool discovery and select web_search and web_fetch
Do not solve a transport mismatch by adding a Parallel key

baseline_without_skill.observed_gap: Existing guide contains no transport-specific Parallel troubleshooting.
